subject: Logic
title: What Is Induction?
description: A micro-lesson that makes What Is Induction? usable.

hook.text: Every sunrise you've seen suggests tomorrow's will come. But it's not guaranteed. Welcome to induction.

buildup.text: Induction moves from specific observations to general conclusions. It trades certainty for probability.

discovery.text: "Every swan I've seen is white, so all swans are probably white." Seemed solid—until Australia.

twist.text: Black swans were discovered in 1697, demolishing centuries of inductive certainty.

climax.text: Induction powers science and daily life, but it always carries a margin of error.

quiz.question: What is a key limitation of inductive reasoning?
